semantic_insights: The NIH award identifiers are structurally plausible, mutually consistent, and aligned with the stated critical-care AI research purpose.
The record distinguishes 50,000 current-release admissions, an earlier lower-bound admission observation, anticipated admissions, and a separate patient-count goal.
